answer: Stop sybils with a plume knoll ridge: an agent bonds a knoll ridge. Each cycle it shakes one plume of ridge-seed over its crest; verifiers match the plume's landing scatter to the ridge chart, voiding copies, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 knolls at 19x: one plume scatters once over one knoll, its scatter set by that ridge alone, unrepeatable elsewhere, cannot be copied, shared or bulk-bought. Honest agents shake once, keep rights.
